0b2a2cd338a5.en: Real-world comparison: bardcore (or tavernwave), medieval-style remakes of modern songs played on lutes, pipes, hurdy-gurdies and the like.
0b2a2cd338a5.t: 现实世界的对照：bardcore（或 tavernwave），用鲁特琴、风笛、手摇琴之类的乐器演奏的中世纪风格的现代歌曲翻版。

11f327355f14.en: Rules: certain Soul Energy interfaces and nari gels are allowed.
11f327355f14.t: 规则：允许使用某些灵魂能量界面和纳里凝胶。

155e0dc6f8ed.en: Rules: the board looks like a bird's-eye view of a baseball field rotated into a full circle, split into zones of different colors. Each player gets a bag of darts in their own colors. Everyone throws at the same time, against a set time (until they run out of darts), while a third person keeps track of the territories claimed. Landing on a color region scores a point; land on a region that holds someone else's dart, and the two cancel out. The smaller the region, the more it's worth, and some territories (yellow, for example) are worth more if you snipe them all. Hiromi teaches Harry the game in Vol 2.
155e0dc6f8ed.t: 规则：靶盘看起来像是把一个棒球场的鸟瞰图旋转成一整个圆，分成不同颜色的区域。每个玩家拿到一袋自己颜色的飞镖。所有人同时投掷，在规定的时间内（直到飞镖用完），由第三个人记录被占领的领地。投中一个颜色区域得一分；投中一个已经有别人飞镖的区域，两者就互相抵消。区域越小，价值越高，有些领地（比如黄色的）如果你全部狙下来，价值会更高。弘美在 Vol 2 里教哈利玩这个游戏。

1aab81afd4f3.en: Rules: big duels between well-known duelists are held in Forway's theaters for people to watch, and in arenas, sometimes as a team deathmatch.
1aab81afd4f3.t: 规则：知名决斗者之间的大型决斗会在福威的剧院里举行供人观看，也会在竞技场举行，有时是团队死斗。

1d7938fbe083.en: A common sport in Forway, played with a nari gel that allows flight.
1d7938fbe083.t: 福威的一项常见运动，使用一种能让人飞行的纳里凝胶来进行。

2f0556a3e84e.en: A darts game all about capturing territory and holding onto it.
2f0556a3e84e.t: 一种以占领领地并守住它为核心的飞镖游戏。

3e3553c3c87d.en: Rules: two teams of five: four attackers on each side, and a fifth player on each team who is the goalkeeper and strategist. The teams take turns fighting in the center (like American football) to advance past the flags. Each turn has five chances to advance the ball and drop it in the "nests" on each pole.
3e3553c3c87d.t: 规则：两队，每队五人：每边四名进攻者，每队还有第五名队员担任守门员兼战术师。两队轮流在中间争斗（就像美式橄榄球），以推进越过旗帜。每一轮有五次机会推进球，并把它投进每根柱子上的“巢”里。

43cd20b14a71.en: Common in Forway City. Theaters recreate novels or tell entirely different stories.
43cd20b14a71.t: 在福威城很常见。剧院会重现小说，或者讲完全不同的故事。

49bcb1a96681.en: Rules: the performer uses everything in the Soul Energy interface books to entertain guests creatively. It's also done on the street: someone wowing kids by touching different powers to make different kinds of flames, like a flamethrower or a firework show.
49bcb1a96681.t: 规则：表演者运用灵魂能量界面书里的一切，有创意地娱乐客人。在街头也有人这么做：有人通过触碰不同的力量做出不同种类的火焰，比如喷火器或烟花表演，让孩子们惊叹不已。

515a4aebfeeb.en: More common in Forway: a fancier version of Stealball for richer people who love the game but don't want to be seen playing it on public streets.
515a4aebfeeb.t: 在福威更常见：斯蒂尔博尔的一个更花哨的版本，给那些喜欢这个游戏、又不想被人看到在公共街道上玩的富人。

51cd41ff9b8f.en: Rules: based on Hammerschlagen (also called Stump), a German game not many people know. Each player starts with a nail half driven into a waist-high stump; on your turn, you get a single swing at your nail with the wedge end of the hammer, and the first to drive theirs flush into the wood wins. Using different types of wood, like Soul Wood or a Rakuja tree, makes it harder.
51cd41ff9b8f.t: 规则：基于 Hammerschlagen（也叫 Stump），一种没多少人知道的德国游戏。每个玩家开始时都有一根钉子半钉在齐腰高的树桩上；轮到你时，你只能用锤子的楔形端敲一下自己的钉子，第一个把钉子完全钉进木头里的人获胜。使用不同种类的木头，比如灵魂木或拉库贾树，会让难度更大。

5346217bf9e8.en: Getting drunk is fun. Most people have a favorite tavern that becomes a second home, and dedicated restaurants are a strange concept. Some taverns, usually in Forway City, require memberships to keep their standing as high-class establishments. Tavern-hopping is a common trend for adventurers and travelers wanting to taste different things.
5346217bf9e8.t: 喝醉很好玩。大多数人都有一家最喜欢的酒馆，成了第二个家，而专门的餐馆是一个奇怪的概念。有些酒馆（通常在福威城）要求会员资格，以保持它们作为高档场所的地位。逛酒馆是冒险者和想尝尝不同东西的旅行者中的一种常见潮流。

55023003a870.en: Rules: depends on who's hosting, but it's usually annual.
55023003a870.t: 规则：取决于谁主办，但通常一年一次。

5adce264d753.en: Summary written by AI from the author's notes (Sports, Games and Passtime.md). AI disclosure
5adce264d753.t: 由 AI 根据作者笔记撰写的摘要（Sports, Games and Passtime.md）。AI 使用说明

5dbc94c34f1a.en: Rules: throw small pieces of bone from a set spot into sacks placed around the room, usually at weird heights or in awkward places. Commonly, you take a big gulp of your drink every time you miss.
5dbc94c34f1a.t: 规则：从固定的位置把小块骨头扔进摆在房间周围的袋子里，袋子通常放在奇怪的高度或别扭的地方。通常每次没投中，你就要大口喝一口酒。

663acd3708a5.en: Officially held in Forway City, but in some other places as well.
663acd3708a5.t: 官方在福威城举办，但其他一些地方也有。

66e600ed5117.en: Real-world comparison: much like Ringer, the classic marbles game, where players shoot marbles out of a ring and keep the ones they knock out.
66e600ed5117.t: 现实世界的对照：很像 Ringer，经典的弹珠游戏，玩家把弹珠打出圆圈，打出去的就归自己。

69d982bd455f.en: 23 more entries on this page are only in <button class="linklike" data-go-bts>Behind The Scenes</button>.
69d982bd455f.t: 本页另有 23 个条目仅在<button class="linklike" data-go-bts>幕后</button>中提供。

6f8c6c5fe900.en: Rules: anything goes, except flight or gravity Soul Energy interfaces.
6f8c6c5fe900.t: 规则：什么都可以，除了飞行或重力类的灵魂能量界面。

712bffa8e9f8.en: Like a Gandew duel, but here Soul Energy and nari gels are encouraged. There are no formal rules; it's more of a common saying.
712bffa8e9f8.t: 就像甘杜决斗，但在这里鼓励使用灵魂能量和纳里凝胶。没有正式的规则；它更像是一个常用的说法。

73e4ac3985a7.en: Rules: like Gwent, but with carved statues instead of cards. The statues are usually bound with a nari stone, and Soul Energy reflects their powers.
73e4ac3985a7.t: 规则：就像昆特牌（Gwent），但用雕刻的雕像代替卡牌。雕像通常和一块纳里石绑定，灵魂能量会体现出它们的力量。

7992ac6edb1b.en: Held in some places; Tolerideme's alcohol competition is famous.
7992ac6edb1b.t: 在一些地方举办；托勒里德梅的酒比赛很有名。

7a90f834f5a6.en: Source: Legacy/Behind The Scenes/World Lore/Sports, Games and Passtime.md
7a90f834f5a6.t: 来源：Legacy/Behind The Scenes/World Lore/Sports, Games and Passtime.md

84e4c203ffde.en: A nari gel-powered flying race, held in a few places but usually in Forway City. Like an olympiad, it shows who has the best body, mind and nari gel.
84e4c203ffde.t: 一种靠纳里凝胶驱动的飞行比赛，在几个地方举办，但通常在福威城。就像奥运会一样，它展示谁拥有最好的身体、头脑和纳里凝胶。

88d8ceb082cb.en: A nari gel-powered swimming race, held in a few places but most famous between Waterfall and the Sanbi Kingdom: people compete to see who swims the farthest. Like an olympiad, it shows who has the best body, mind and nari gel.
88d8ceb082cb.t: 一种靠纳里凝胶驱动的游泳比赛，在几个地方举办，但最有名的是在沃特福尔和桑比王国之间：人们比赛看谁游得最远。就像奥运会一样，它展示谁拥有最好的身体、头脑和纳里凝胶。

8df80c5cf23e.en: Duels are common between Gandew residents, since that's how they resolve their disputes.
8df80c5cf23e.t: 决斗在甘杜居民之间很常见，因为他们就是这样解决争端的。

9453263b580b.en: Sports, Games and Passtime (World Lore illustration)
9453263b580b.t: 体育、游戏与消遣（世界观插图）

95e51354e21e.en: Rules: see the Gandew Common Duel Rights & Law on Laws & Treaties. No Soul Energy tampering allowed.
95e51354e21e.t: 规则：见法律与条约上的甘杜普通决斗权利与法律。不允许用灵魂能量做手脚。

965d570bd9cf.en: Novels of old tales float around, usually for richer people who can read.
965d570bd9cf.t: 讲述古老故事的小说四处流传，通常是给识字的富人看的。

988d45152d42.en: How people in Vraki have fun. Sports include Homeegg, a Forway team sport played in the air with the help of nari gels, plus Fast Fish, Fast Bird, fishing…
988d45152d42.t: 弗拉基人的娱乐方式。体育运动包括霍姆埃格——一种借助纳里凝胶在空中进行的福威团队运动，还有法斯特菲什、法斯特伯德、钓鱼……

9bd91ea0627a.en: Usually for adventurers or richer folks: exploring points of interest in different cities and enjoying the scenery.
9bd91ea0627a.t: 通常是冒险者或比较富裕的人的消遣：探索不同城市的景点，欣赏风景。

a3cad22f4341.en: It started with carved wooden statues and evolved over time. One statue in a group is the true one (the one with a nari stone inside), and the goal is to eliminate it. The table is carved in 3D, with pieces that plug in and out.
a3cad22f4341.t: 它起源于雕刻的木头雕像，随着时间推移不断演变。一组雕像中有一个是真的（里面有纳里石的那个），目标就是消灭它。桌子是立体雕刻的，棋子可以插上和拔下。

aa660cff0c9b.t: 菲什卡奇菲什和钓鱼比赛

b721ce6edb7e.en: Rules: certain Soul Energy enhancements can be applied to the eguas to make things more entertaining.
b721ce6edb7e.t: 规则：可以对埃瓜施加某些灵魂能量增强，让比赛更精彩。

b8a7fc85cba5.en: Rules: roulette. Everyone usually puts in an equal amount, placing balls in the open slots. The spinner spins the wooden bowl and drops in a white ball; wherever it lands, the spinner gets the prize.
b8a7fc85cba5.t: 规则：轮盘赌。每个人通常投入相同的数额，把球放进空的格子里。转盘手转动木碗，丢进一个白球；它落在哪里，转盘手就拿到奖品。

bb75cc9f78ff.en: Because sticking your dick in, or the reverse, or both, depending on taste, is fun.
bb75cc9f78ff.t: 因为把你的屌插进去，或者反过来，或者两者都来，看口味，很好玩。

bd27f1856c4b.en: Rules: like Stealball, but on a table with ground nari stones added, and with three players. A Table Manager applies effects to the table and sets dead zones where the table wins the balls. The players fight each other, or team up against the table; if they team up, the table can make an underhanded proposal, or raise the difficulty while raising the pot. Table powers include bounce, slow, fast and sink zones, splitting a ball, and a hard ball that won't move.
bd27f1856c4b.t: 规则：和斯蒂尔博尔一样，但在一张加了磨碎纳里石的桌子上进行，有三个玩家。一名桌面管理员给桌子施加效果，并设置死区，球落在那里就归桌子。玩家们互相争斗，或者联手对抗桌子；如果他们联手，桌子可以提出一个阴险的提议，或者在加大赌注的同时提高难度。桌子的能力包括弹跳区、减速区、加速区和下沉区，把一个球一分为二，以及一个推不动的硬球。

c1b58c653f09.en: How people in Vraki have fun. Sports include Homeegg, a Forway team sport played in the air with the help of nari gels, plus Fast Fish, Fast Bird, fishing contests, Gandew and Forway duels, and egua races. Games include Territory Snipping, Stealball and Minari. For pastimes there's music, tavern-hopping, reading, theater and tourism.
c1b58c653f09.t: 弗拉基人的娱乐方式。体育运动包括霍姆埃格——一种借助纳里凝胶在空中进行的福威团队运动，还有法斯特菲什、法斯特伯德、钓鱼比赛、甘杜和福威的决斗，以及埃瓜赛跑。游戏包括特里托里斯尼平、斯蒂尔博尔和米纳里。消遣方面有音乐、逛酒馆、阅读、戏剧和旅游。

cdcd2ee416c4.en: Rules: certain Soul Energy enhancements can be applied to the eguas and riders to make things more entertaining. All weapons allowed.
cdcd2ee416c4.t: 规则：可以对埃瓜和骑手施加某些灵魂能量增强，让比赛更精彩。允许使用所有武器。

ce3125e13a22.en: Held in a few places, but usually in Sanbi.
ce3125e13a22.t: 在几个地方举办，但通常在桑比。

d1a45690c791.en: Rules: draw a large square on the ground and put an equal number of balls (amethyst or higher) in the center. Then use pearl balls to knock the balls in the center out of the square and steal them. In poorer communities, pearl balls go in the center and small rocks do the stealing.
d1a45690c791.t: 规则：在地上画一个大正方形，在中间放上数量相等的球（阿米西斯特或更高）。然后用珀尔球把中间的球打出正方形，把它们偷走。在比较穷的社区，中间放的是珀尔球，用小石头来偷。

dccea8b2bfc8.en: Music is still medieval, but with some vibes from today's notes and rhythms; no electric guitars or anything like that.
dccea8b2bfc8.t: 音乐仍然是中世纪式的，但带着一些当今音符和节奏的感觉；没有电吉他之类的东西。

f906abc225f1.en: Rules: Fish Catch Fish is literally fishing with your hands and skills, swimming with the power of nari gels. Depending on the competition, the winner is decided by the size of the catch, the time, or the quantity.
f906abc225f1.t: 规则：菲什卡奇菲什就是字面意思：用你的双手和技巧捕鱼，靠纳里凝胶的力量游泳。根据比赛的不同，获胜者由捕获物的大小、时间或数量决定。
